title: Ring push guide: APNs VoIP push (iOS)
description: Section on iOS ring delivery. PushKit VoIP push type (apns-push-type: voip). CallKit CXProvider integration. VTCCallPush payload→CXCallUpdate mapping. Background app wake behavior. Required entitlements (voip, push-to-talk). Apple's PushKit abuse detection (must report call to CallKit or app gets killed). TTL and collapse-id for ring dedup. JSON example of APNs payload.
